# NeuromorphicHarmonyEncoding

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A method for encoding harmonic progressions as spiking neural activity patterns that preserve temporal and relational structure of musical chords. Bridges symbolic music generation with event-driven neuromorphic hardware, enabling low-power real-time composition.
